question:
**Select the most appropriate SYNONYM of the given word.**

Seize
solution:
The correct answer is "**Catch".**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Seize** means to take something quickly and keep or hold it.

 
 
• **Example**: I ***seized*** his arm and made him turn to look at me.
 
 
 
• Marked option **Catch** means taking hold of something, especially one moving through the air.
 
 
• **Example**: I managed to ***catch*** the glass before it hit the ground.
 
 
 
• Clearly, **'Seize'** and **'Catch' **are similar meanings. 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1.​ **

**​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Offer** means to ask someone if they would like to have something or if they would like you to do something.
 
• **Shut** means to close something.
 
• ** Losing** means no longer having something because you do not know where it is.**​**
